regime_map.title: Regime Map
regime_map.why_it_matters: The macro regime quadrant determines which asset classes face structural headwinds versus tailwinds.

sections.question: Which macro quadrant best describes current cross-asset dynamics?
sections.answer: The 20-day window sits in risk-on easing: dollar is softening, real yields are declining, and VIX is below its median — a backdrop that historically supports risk assets.
sections.why: Quadrant transitions are more informative than spot levels; the direction of dollar and real yield change over 20 days typically leads equity beta by one to two weeks.
sections.risk: A rapid dollar reversal or real yield spike could shift the quadrant to global-tightening risk-off within days.
sections.support: Fragility score remains below 40, limiting the tail risk of abrupt quadrant exit.
sections.caveat: 60D and 120D windows still show mixed regime, tempering conviction on the 20D read.
